title: X1: The macOS app's store is not in the App Group

description: macOS uses StoreConfiguration.defaultOnDisk (Apps/Lillist-macOS/Sources/AppEnvironment.swift:374, the sandbox container) while iOS uses appGroupOnDisk. Failure scenario: the macOS widget resolves the App Group path, finds nothing, and opens/creates a SECOND, empty Lillist.sqlite; it shows zero data, and in iCloudSync mode arms its own mirroring delegate, importing the ENTIRE ACCOUNT into that throwaway file. Violates the repo's own Plan 8 rule that the App Group container is the only sanctioned path for app/extension store sharing. Also folds in the related but unnumbered detail: iOS itself has a silent defaultOnDisk fallback path (AppEnvironment.swift:431) - a 4th store-location divergence, verified. Severity: Critical. Wave/Plan: Wave 1, plan 1c store-location-unification. Sweep: cross-process. Verified directly against source. Class-killer: canonical StoreLocation resolver (role: app/extension/cli/widget) as the only path authority for all six processes; macOS App Support -> App Group one-time migration (closed-store copy); only apps arm mirroring.
